chapter.title: Wrong Place, Wrong Millennium
chapter.subtitle: The road home is open. The damage is still here.
chapter.description: Anunaki Arrival · Chapter 7. The road home is open. The damage is still here.

tips: Complete the chapter to advance. Optional stars never block the next chapter.

scenes.speaker: Nabu
scenes.text: Your engine has been pulling the arrival gate out of sequence since you landed. The field is tearing.

scenes.speaker: Captain Jigga
scenes.text: If we leave now, it stops pulling. Right?

scenes.speaker: Nabu
scenes.text: It pulls the tear with you.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: We came here by accident. We leave by choice. And we leave this place standing.

scenes.speaker: Captain Jigga
scenes.text: Alright. Tell me what to hold.

tips: Build Tablets in separate districts so you can choose which resource to spend later.
Any temporary ally is for this encounter only. Collectible unlocks come from the journey or featured banner.

passive.name: Ancient Field
passive.description: Build Tablets in separate districts so you can choose which resource to spend later.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

preDialogue.speaker: Nabu
preDialogue.text: The archive, gate and conduit are slipping into different moments. We synchronize them in that order.

preDialogue.speaker: Captain Jigga
preDialogue.text: Three clocks. None of them have snooze.

postDialogue.speaker: Nabu
postDialogue.text: Archive synchronized. You bought the others time.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

tips: The middle district closes in round 3. Watch the announced lock and hold the outside route.
Any temporary ally is for this encounter only. Collectible unlocks come from the journey or featured banner.

passive.name: Ancient Field
passive.description: The middle district closes in round 3. Watch the announced lock and hold the outside route.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

preDialogue.speaker: Enlil
preDialogue.text: I can ground the conduit if you keep both flanks clear.

preDialogue.speaker: Captain Jigga
preDialogue.text: Holding the flanks. Look at me following instructions.

postDialogue.speaker: Enlil
postDialogue.text: Conduit stable. The pressure will return at the gate.

postDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
postDialogue.text: We will be there before it does.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

tips: Complete the chapter to advance. Optional stars never block the next chapter.

scenes.speaker: Nabu
scenes.text: The record is complete. Read each clue before moving the pieces. A correct sequence is safer than a quick guess.

puzzle.title: One Timeline, Three Districts
puzzle.instruction: Restore the recorded order. Archive stores the destination before the conduit can charge. The conduit charges before the gate opens. The machine jumps only after the gate opens.

pieces.label: Archive destination
pieces.detail: The coordinates must exist before power is applied.

pieces.label: Jump machine
pieces.detail: Travel begins through the open gate.

hints: Information before power, power before passage.
puzzle.solvedText: All three districts share the same sequence. The breach can be closed from the arrival gate, but somebody must hold it through the final charge.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew works through the clues with you. You continue with the same story progress and rewards.

tips: Use your temporary Inanna to turn a banked Tablet into district power.
Any temporary ally is for this encounter only. Collectible unlocks come from the journey or featured banner.

passive.description: Use your temporary Inanna to turn a banked Tablet into district power.

preDialogue.speaker: Inanna
preDialogue.text: The machine can still carry two. You could abandon this fight.

preDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
preDialogue.text: That is why staying must mean something.

postDialogue.speaker: Inanna
postDialogue.text: Then I stand with you. No audience required.

postDialogue.speaker: Captain Jigga
postDialogue.text: Good. My brave face was getting heavy.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

tips: Borrow Anu. One Tablet reduces his cost by 2; his reveal consumes the rest. This is raid training.

phases.name: Gate Pressure
phases.description: At round 4, Nabu joins the enemy hand once. Prepare another district before the pressure arrives.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

preDialogue.speaker: Anu
preDialogue.text: You ask to repair a fault in our first arrival. Prove your plan can withstand its pressure.

preDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
preDialogue.text: Test the plan. We will answer for our part.

postDialogue.speaker: Anu
postDialogue.text: You understand the sequence. The actual gate will offer no rehearsal.

postDialogue.speaker: Captain Jigga
postDialogue.text: Training completed. My knees would like the certificate.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

tips: Complete the chapter to advance. Optional stars never block the next chapter.

scenes.speaker: Nabu
scenes.text: I saved the sequence in the training archive. You can rehearse it again before the last gate.

scenes.speaker: Captain Jigga
scenes.text: Yasuke. When this works, do you still want that ride?

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: I want the choice. You gave me that. Now let us make it a safe one.

scenes.speaker: Anu
scenes.text: Then come. The first arrival awaits its final correction.
